versions.changelog:
Initial release – find and analyze trending Twitter topics for timely content ideas.

- Finds trending conversations, hashtags, and tweet clusters in any niche or industry using Apify's tweet scraper.
- Returns trending topics, tweet volume signals, engagement stats, content angle suggestions, and top example tweets.
- Supports detailed filtering (by language, verified status, media, author, location, date range, engagement thresholds, and more).
- Scores topic opportunities by velocity, engagement, freshness, and influencer presence to help prioritize content.
- Output ready for content marketers, social media managers, newsletter writers, and teams needing real-time inspiration.
- Includes workflow, edge case handling, and troubleshooting in documentation.
